g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access Several basket endpoints load a basket or basket item by an id from the request. They require authentication through isAuthorized, and appendUserId on /rest/basket (server.ts:356, 399), but never check that the object belongs to the caller. At routes/basket.ts:19 (also reported at server.ts:603), GET /rest/basket/:id runs BasketModel.findOne({ where: { id } }) with the path id only, so any registered user can enumerate ids and read other customers' baskets and products. At routes/basketItems.ts:68 (also reported at server.ts:426), PUT /api/BasketItems/:id loads the item by id alone and only checks stock quantity and limits. It neither verifies that the item is in the caller's basket nor blocks a changed BasketId, and it hands the request to the generic finale update, which was not read. An authenticated user can therefore change quantities in other users' baskets or move items between baskets. At routes/coupon.ts:18, PUT /rest/basket/:id/coupon/:coupon calls BasketModel.findByPk(id) and updates the coupon, so any authenticated user can set or clear coupons on other customers' baskets. At routes/order.ts:35, POST /rest/basket/<victimBasketId>/checkout makes placeOrder load the basket by path id only. It decrements stock and deletes the victim's basket items (line 51), while the order and the bonus credit go to the attacker's appended UserId. The handlers detect some of these mismatches only to solve a challenge. The finding holds 8 locations, more than the locations its parts cite. C-04 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Authorization is implemented route by route (W-005) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

C-04 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-001) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data
g.text: Stored username runs as server code

g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication At routes/chat.ts:45, getUserId decodes the bearer token with security.decode (jws.decode, insecurity.ts:56) and never verifies its signature. An attacker sends POST /rest/chat with a self-made or unsigned JWT whose data.id is the victim's user id and asks for one of the victim's orders. The getOrderById tool loads the victim's email and returns any order whose masked email matches it, so the victim's order details are returned. The victim's username is also placed in the system prompt. The ownership check at chat.ts:169 relies on the unverified identity. It also compares emails with their vowels masked, so different emails can collide and still pass. updateAuthenticatedUsers verifies tokens but does not reject invalid ones, and no signature verification happens anywhere in the chat route. In the survey's terms (ASI03), the tool acts on an identity the agent never verified. C-04 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Authentication relies on hand-rolled token verification (W-003) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets At routes/fileUpload.ts:34, an unauthenticated attacker uploads a .zip to /file-upload with entries named, for example, ../../ftp/legal.md or ../../frontend/dist/frontend/main.js. Each entry path is joined to uploads/complaints/. The only check is absolutePath.includes(path.resolve('.')), which accepts any target inside the application directory, so the handler can overwrite application files or served frontend assets. checkFileType and checkUploadSize always call next() and never reject a file. The only size limit is the 200 KB multer limit on the compressed upload, so the decompressed size is not limited. The verification part notes that this behavior is gated by the fileWriteChallenge flag. C-04 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Input handling lacks enforced boundary validation (W-004) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Scripts into Victim Browsers I craft a search URL whose q parameter holds an iframe with a javascript: source and send it to a logged-in victim. C-05 · Angular Frontend No account required; Victim interaction required Frontend rendering lacks enforced output encoding (W-007) Technical consequence not established. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data
